<div class='command-title'>Define a signature for an external command.</div>

## Command Type

`keyword`

## Signature

```> extern {flags} (def_name) (params)```

## Parameters

 -  `def_name`: The name of the external command signature to define.
 -  `params`: The parameters for the external command signature.


## Input/output types:

| input   | output  |
| ------- | ------- |
| nothing | nothing |
## Examples

Write a signature for an external command.
```nu
> extern echo [text: string]

```
